summary: Force-balance, boundary-residual and solver-convergence checks PASS for the polished L16/M16/N9 PF634 equilibrium. G2 is not closed: the stability screen, CAD/clearance regeneration and the formal acceptance decision remain open (see 'remaining').

candidate.design: PF634 (21/221/36/114/21/221 turns), exported MGRID at documented operating currents

normalized_force_rms_G2_gate.definition: |J x B - grad p| / <|grad(|B|^2)|/2mu0>_vol, RMS on the dense force grid

pressure_scaled_force.definition: RMS|F| / RMS|grad p|, volume-weighted, 20 radii 0.025-0.995, M32/N15 grid
pressure_scaled_force.per_radius_note: Per-radius ratio exceeds 1% only at rho <= 0.18, where grad p is 205-18,760 N/m3; absolute force there is 216-433 N/m3, the lowest in the plasma. A per-radius limit should start at rho >= 0.2 or use an absolute floor (decision pending).

resolution_convergence.proposed_rule: each region changes < 10% from N6 to N9, or stays below 0.1%
options: Accept: all limits pass at two successive converged resolutions with >= 2.7x margin; N3->N6->N9 extrapolates to ~0.37% at the edge surface
Run N12 (toroidal mode 192, next 48-coil ripple harmonic) to meet the 10% rule strictly
